ec2-cpu-high.nrql: SELECT average(aws.ec2.CPUUtilization) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ec2.InstanceId = 'i-0abc123def4567890' AND aws.ec2.AutoScalingGroupName IS NULL AND aws.ec2.ImageId IS NULL AND aws.ec2.InstanceType IS NULL

rds-cpu-high.nrql: SELECT average(aws.rds.CPUUtilization) FROM Metric WHERE aws.rds.DBInstanceIdentifier = 'prod-db-1' AND aws.rds.DBClusterIdentifier IS NULL AND aws.rds.DatabaseClass IS NULL AND aws.rds.EngineName IS NULL AND aws.rds.Role IS NULL AND aws.rds.SourceRegion IS NULL

rds-free-storage-low.nrql: SELECT min(aws.rds.FreeStorageSpace) FROM Metric WHERE aws.rds.DBInstanceIdentifier = 'prod-db-1' AND aws.rds.DBClusterIdentifier IS NULL AND aws.rds.DatabaseClass IS NULL AND aws.rds.EngineName IS NULL AND aws.rds.Role IS NULL AND aws.rds.SourceRegion IS NULL

rds-connections-3-of-5.nrql: SELECT average(aws.rds.DatabaseConnections) FROM Metric WHERE aws.rds.DBInstanceIdentifier = 'prod-db-1' AND aws.rds.DBClusterIdentifier IS NULL AND aws.rds.DatabaseClass IS NULL AND aws.rds.EngineName IS NULL AND aws.rds.Role IS NULL AND aws.rds.SourceRegion IS NULL

alb-5xx-any.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.applicationelb.HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count) FROM Metric WHERE aws.applicationelb.LoadBalancer = 'app/my-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188' AND aws.applicationelb.AvailabilityZone IS NULL AND aws.applicationelb.TargetGroup IS NULL

alb-latency-p99.nrql: SELECT max(aws.applicationelb.TargetResponseTime.p99) FROM Metric WHERE aws.applicationelb.LoadBalancer = 'app/my-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188' AND aws.applicationelb.AvailabilityZone IS NULL AND aws.applicationelb.TargetGroup IS NULL

lambda-errors.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.lambda.Errors.byFunction) FROM Metric WHERE aws.lambda.FunctionName = 'checkout' AND aws.lambda.ExecutedVersion IS NULL AND aws.lambda.Resource IS NULL

lambda-duration-high.nrql: SELECT average(aws.lambda.Duration.byFunction) FROM Metric WHERE aws.lambda.FunctionName = 'checkout' AND aws.lambda.ExecutedVersion IS NULL AND aws.lambda.Resource IS NULL

dynamodb-throttled.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.dynamodb.ThrottledRequests) FROM Metric WHERE aws.dynamodb.TableName = 'orders' AND aws.dynamodb.Operation = 'PutItem' AND aws.dynamodb.GlobalSecondaryIndexName IS NULL AND aws.dynamodb.ReceivingRegion IS NULL AND aws.dynamodb.StreamLabel IS NULL

ecs-service-cpu.nrql: SELECT average(aws.ecs.CPUUtilization) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ecs.ClusterName = 'prod' AND aws.ecs.ServiceName = 'api'

lambda-error-rate.nrql: SELECT sum(aws.lambda.Errors.byFunction) / sum(aws.lambda.Invocations.byFunction) * 100 FROM Metric WHERE aws.lambda.FunctionName = 'checkout' AND aws.lambda.ExecutedVersion IS NULL AND aws.lambda.Resource IS NULL

ec2-network-in.nrql: SELECT average(aws.ec2.NetworkIn) FROM Metric WHERE aws.ec2.InstanceId = 'i-0abc123def4567890' AND aws.ec2.AutoScalingGroupName IS NULL AND aws.ec2.ImageId IS NULL AND aws.ec2.InstanceType IS NULL
